title: Warehouse #500: restore guarded assembly split discovery for qty1/qty6
head: fix/warehouse-500-split-visibility
body:
Refs #500; focused follow-up to Draft PR #499, based on exact head 4ddc219.

Reproduced source defects on PR499: positioned bumper names (Бампер (передній)/(задній)) fail frontend and backend exact-family recognition; the split disclosure also disappears on preview failure and is below other inspector controls. Add conservative exact aliases on both sides, move the existing guarded action above preview/photo, and explain qty6 unit reconciliation without creating six physical units or changing stock. Existing backend permissions/reservation/qty1/token guards remain unchanged.

Important: the REAL staging root cause is still UNVERIFIED. If the owner's quantity warning is literally from bundle4ddc219, recognition already passed, so alias mismatch alone cannot explain that screenshot. One staging request returned CONNECT403; no authenticated staging session available. Do not claim live browser PASS or close #500 until actual asset/DOM/role/flag/scroll evidence is collected.

Validation: 55 backend regressions PASS on fresh isolated localhost PostgreSQL *_test databases; 251 frontend tests + TypeScript/Vite build PASS. Authenticated local real-app/PG browser before/after at1440/390 reproduces qty1/qty6 plus door/engine. Diagnostic snapshots prove no mutations; separately opted-in LOCAL confirmation creates two components, preserves original root Part/qty1, leaves front lot6 and all original Part IDs unchanged. Preview503 fault is explicitly injected local evidence. Favicon404 is retained as a pre-existing preview warning, not hidden.

Before/after screenshots, console/network/role reports, staging read-only browser command and acceptance plan: warehouse/docs/issue-500/README.md.

No source branch/main/shared staging push, production, Railway DB, worker, Variables, real donor/stock changes, migrations, merge or deployment. Qty6 lot-unit extraction is intentionally not implemented; cost allocation is not automatic. Review API+Web patch together; stage only after source review and authorized environment checks.
